credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/monstera.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: BRACED: a propagation cutting turned critter, the stout node braced on two aerial-root legs, the young split leaf held up on its petiole like a shield. Intro: the shield leaf is still rolled; it unfurls, FANS OPEN past rest with its splits gaping, and settles. Crystal rule: deep blue-green dark (roots, stem, leaf shade), leaf green light, white rims. Sport: Monstera deliciosa 'Aurea' (lime-gold).
